crashCases.killPoint: commit-boundary race after marker and before process exit

limits: Synthetic rows are not an application workload.
A killed process cannot tell a flushed commit from one in the operating system cache; the durability settings are read back instead.
The crash cases exercise one local filesystem and do not establish disk-loss survival or multi-host failover.
The bbolt comparison and the benchmark timings are spike evidence from cmd/store-spike (ADR 0003, spike-linux-arm64-go1.27.1.json); no test re-runs them.
